_note: Research demonstrator — not a medical device. ALL CONTENT IS PLACEHOLDER (R-08). It names what a responder carries and reminders only; it is not treatment instruction. Real content, per deployment region, must come from a toxinologist. Antivenom products are region- and species-specific.

reminders: Carry bag-valve-mask ventilation support — it is the bridge if neurotoxic paralysis affects breathing
